schema.step.kind: prompt = demon line offering options | choice = resolution of a chosen option | branch = conditional result (good/bad, higher/lower, Pass/Fail)
schema.step.parent: id of the step this follows from (prompt for choices, choice for nested prompts/branches)
schema.step.outcome: {type, raw, ...} terminal result: enemy_phase, bargain_phase, leaves, instant_recruit, gives_item, gives_macca, talk_end, dialogue_switch{to}, stat_check{stat,between}, random, next_section, ...
schema.step.alternativeOf: when several random responses exist for the same option

notes: The wiki renders each negotiation topic as an ordered table; this file keeps that order and infers parent links via the listed options.
Options without stepIds have no matching resolution row in the source table (the wiki article is still under construction); they are preserved as listed choices.
Eight 'moon phase' topics consist only of [GOOD OUTCOME]/[BAD OUTCOME] rows in the source; they get a synthetic prompt (marker 'moon_phase') as their root.
Two topic headers ('Quiz' in Tough, 'Bow' in Rookie) lost their align="center" attribute in the wiki; they are still detected as topics.
Some table cells are empty in the source (incomplete article); those lines are preserved as empty/none values.
Line breaks inside a line are the game's text breaks (kept as \n).
